newsitem.title: UK: Euro VGO barges boosted by strong German buying.
newsitem.headline: Euro VGO barges boosted by strong German buying.

text.p: European VGO markets found end-week support in Germany with heavy demand there for May barges, traders said.
"The Germans seemed to wake up this week and buy bundles of VGO for May," said one trader. He estimated some 50,000 tonnes of material, mainly low sulphur, had been snapped up.

Low sulphur barges gained two to three dollars on Friday alone, with bids hitting $134 and offers $136. A rumoured problem at a big German desulphurisation plant helped explain the preference for low sulphur material, traders said.
In contrast cargo prices slipped back on lack of interest. U.S. demand has vanished with dealers holding off buying while they assess the effect of shutdowns at two U.S. crackers.
"People are on hold over there, just watching and waiting at the moment," said a dealer.
High sulphur VGO availabilities across Europe were reported good, depressing prices, with sellers trying to divert material into the barge market, traders said.
